proposed_comments.title: Include directories in bookmark payloads (1/2)
proposed_comments.body:
### Include directories in bookmark payloads (1/2)

**Severity:** `medium`

Directory bookmarks are classified and the shared data-package helper already creates StorageFolder items, but this predicate rejects every directory because it only accepts file kinds and File.Exists.

```suggestion
            classification.Kind is CommandKind.FileExecutable or CommandKind.FileDocument or CommandKind.Shortcut or CommandKind.InternetShortcut or CommandKind.Directory &&
            (File.Exists(classification.Target) || Directory.Exists(classification.Target))
```

proposed_comments.title: Import the ResourceMap stream reference type (1/12)
proposed_comments.body:
### Import the ResourceMap stream reference type (1/12)

**Severity:** `medium`

The resource map stores `RandomAccessStreamReference` values, so the transfer helper needs the WinRT streams namespace before it can copy those entries.

```suggestion
using Windows.ApplicationModel.DataTransfer;
using Windows.Storage.Streams;
```


proposed_comments.body:
### Hold DragStarting open while ResourceMap is read (5/12)

**Severity:** `medium`

Without a drag-start deferral, the event can complete at the first `await` and expose an incomplete package. Acquire the supported deferral before entering the existing error-handling path.

```suggestion
        var deferral = args.GetDeferral();
        try
```

```suggestion

```
